text: So sorry to message this late, I'm probably overreacting. My stepson is 10, he's had a temperature since yesterday, 38.2 tonight. He's got a sticky pink eye as well, the left one, crusty when he woke up. He's completely himself though, wide awake, chatting away, watching his programmes. The thing is I noticed some little freckle-looking dots on his chest and arm that weren't there this morning, I'm fairly sure they weren't anyway. I read about the glass thing so I pressed a glass on them and I think they were still there, I could still see them through it. I might be doing it wrong, I don't know. His dad's away and I don't want to drag everyone out for nothing. Sorry again, I just didn't want to ignore it.
